**What exists now:**\\n  - \\u0060h9k config set --auto-pr-review-mint-hold\\u0060, default 300 s, 0 means never defer. It is a \\u0060DaemonOptions\\u0060 / \\u0060OperatingSettings\\u0060 field, a report row printed by \\u0060config show\\u0060 and \\u0060daemon status\\u0060, and the env var \\u0060Hall9k__AutoPrReviewMintHoldSeconds\\u0060.\\n  - \\u0060EnrolledNodeSnapshots\\u0060, a DI singleton in \\u0060Hall9k.Daemon.AutoPrReview\\u0060. The message sweep writes \\u0060TrustedOwner.FleetNodeIds()\\u0060 into it per project each tick, and the engine reads it.\\n  - \\u0060AutoPrReviewObservation.DecideMintHold\\u0060, a pure function.\\n  - \\u0060ReviewRequestOutcome.HeldForPeer\\u0060, plus \\u0060HoldLeaderNodeId\\u0060 and \\u0060HoldEndsAt\\u0060 on \\u0060ObservedReviewRequest\\u0060 (cleared when the outcome leaves \\u0060HeldForPeer\\u0060).\\n  - A \\u0060ReviewRequestPane\\u0060 branch that shows the row as informational.\\n- **Gotchas:**\\n  - A Project stream\\u0027s \\u0060ProjectRegistered\\u0060 never replicates, so in a two-node test each store must register the project itself (shared project id only scopes replication). See \\u0060Two_nodes_that_both_see_one_request_within_the_hold_end_with_one_mint_one_live_task_and_no_abandon\\u0060.\\n  - The leader\\u0027s display name is read at render time from \\u0060NodeDetails.MachineName\\u0060 and falls back to the short id when unknown.\\n  - Guid \\u0060Min()\\u0060 ordering is the same ordering \\u0060PullRequestReviewDuplicateRule\\u0060 uses.\\n- **Deliberately left undone:**\\n  - Mentions are not held (\\u0060DecideMentionAsync\\u0060 is unchanged; a follow-up may apply the leader rule there).\\n  - No fleet-scoped or chosen-rank leader setting, which the platform lacks.\\n  - The one-sweep double-mint hazard for a newly enrolled lower-id node is accepted, since convergence settles it.\\n  - Windows still needs the hold at 0 for arx-platform until both nodes watch that
